new_nodes.title: Cities should invest heavily in cycling infrastructure
new_nodes.description: A citywide program of protected bike lanes, parking, and intersection upgrades.
new_nodes.speaker: Moderator

new_nodes.title: Cycling cuts transport emissions
new_nodes.description: Shifting short trips from cars to bikes lowers urban CO2 and air pollution.
new_nodes.speaker: Priya

relations.reasoning: Transport is a top-3 urban emissions source; mode shift attacks it directly.

new_nodes.title: Bikes have zero tailpipe emissions
new_nodes.description: Every car trip replaced removes exhaust entirely.
new_nodes.speaker: Priya

relations.reasoning: No combustion means no direct emissions.

new_nodes.title: Life-cycle studies confirm net CO2 savings
new_nodes.description: Even including manufacturing, bikes win on total footprint.
new_nodes.speaker: Sam

relations.reasoning: Production emissions are repaid quickly per km ridden.

new_nodes.title: Frame production is repaid within months
new_nodes.description: Typical riders offset the frame's embodied carbon fast.
new_nodes.quote: "The break-even point arrives after roughly 400 commuted kilometres."
new_nodes.speaker: Sam

relations.reasoning: Commuters cover that distance in the first season.

new_nodes.title: Aluminum recycling closes the loop
new_nodes.description: Frames use highly recyclable alloys, shrinking lifetime impact further.
new_nodes.speaker: Sam

relations.reasoning: Recycled content reduces embodied energy dramatically.

new_nodes.title: Recycled aluminum needs 95% less energy
new_nodes.description: Secondary smelting is vastly cheaper energetically than primary extraction.
new_nodes.quote: "Remelting scrap takes a fraction of the energy of bauxite processing."
new_nodes.speaker: Dana

relations.reasoning: The dominant material cost of frames drops accordingly.

new_nodes.title: Cycling improves public health
new_nodes.description: Regular riding reduces disease burden and healthcare spending.
new_nodes.speaker: Lena

relations.reasoning: Health gains are an independent justification beyond emissions.

new_nodes.title: Riders show lower cardiovascular risk
new_nodes.description: Cohort studies link commuting by bike to healthier hearts.
new_nodes.speaker: Lena

relations.reasoning: Consistent aerobic exercise is the best-evidenced intervention.

new_nodes.title: Large cohort studies agree
new_nodes.description: UK Biobank and Danish cohort data both show the effect.
new_nodes.quote: "Bike commuters had a 41% lower risk of premature death."
new_nodes.speaker: Omar

relations.reasoning: Effects replicate across countries and sample sizes.

new_nodes.title: Benefits persist across age groups
new_nodes.description: The association holds for middle-aged and older adults alike.
new_nodes.speaker: Omar

relations.reasoning: Not an artifact of young, fit early adopters.

new_nodes.title: Active commuting reduces sick days
new_nodes.description: Employers report fewer absences among cycling staff.
new_nodes.speaker: Lena

relations.reasoning: Productivity effects strengthen the economic case.

new_nodes.title: Cycling infrastructure is too expensive
new_nodes.description: Protected networks demand heavy capital and recurring budgets.
new_nodes.speaker: Marcus

relations.reasoning: Costs may outweigh benefits compared to cheaper interventions.

new_nodes.title: Lane mileage costs are high per km
new_nodes.description: Protected lanes cost several times more than paint.
new_nodes.speaker: Marcus

relations.reasoning: Capital budgets are finite and contested.

new_nodes.title: Winter maintenance adds recurring cost
new_nodes.description: Snow clearing and de-icing keep lanes usable but expensive.
new_nodes.speaker: Nadia

relations.reasoning: Northern cities pay annually, not just once.

new_nodes.title: Parking removal has political costs
new_nodes.description: Every lane competes with storage for cars.
new_nodes.speaker: Marcus

relations.reasoning: Implementation risk raises the true price of the program.

new_nodes.title: Intersection signal upgrades are pricey
new_nodes.description: Safe crossings need dedicated signal phases everywhere.
new_nodes.speaker: Nadia

relations.reasoning: Junctions are where most of the cost and danger concentrate.

new_nodes.title: Liability exposure grows for the city
new_nodes.description: New infrastructure classes create novel lawsuit surface.
new_nodes.speaker: Marcus

relations.reasoning: Legal reserves must scale with the network.

new_nodes.title: Enforcement needs new budgets
new_nodes.description: Blocked lanes require active policing or camera programs.
new_nodes.speaker: Nadia

relations.reasoning: Unenforced lanes degrade into parking within months.

new_nodes.title: Planning and consultation fees accumulate
new_nodes.description: Design studies, hearings, and reviews add soft costs at scale.
new_nodes.speaker: Marcus

relations.reasoning: Soft costs can rival construction on long corridors.

new_nodes.title: Opportunity cost diverts funds from transit
new_nodes.description: Bus rapid transit may deliver more benefit per dollar.
new_nodes.quote: "The same corridor moves five times as many people by bus."
new_nodes.speaker: Kai

relations.reasoning: Comparative returns matter more than absolute costs.

new_nodes.title: Weather makes cycling impractical year-round
new_nodes.description: Climate limits ridership in many candidate cities.
new_nodes.speaker: Kai

relations.reasoning: Utilization assumptions drive every projected benefit.

new_nodes.title: Rain and snow suppress ridership
new_nodes.description: Trip counts collapse during wet seasons.
new_nodes.speaker: Kai

relations.reasoning: Idle infrastructure still depreciates.

new_nodes.title: Heat waves deter midday commuting
new_nodes.description: Extreme heat narrows the comfortable riding window.
new_nodes.speaker: Nadia

relations.reasoning: Climate trends push this effect wider each decade.
